author: Taczanowski, 1890
habitat: 서해안·남해안·동해안의 섬, 대나무 숲, 관목 숲, 잡목 숲

months.note: 5월에 번식지 섬에 도착해 5~7월에 알을 낳고(마라도에서는 8월 초까지 알을 품은 기록이 있다) 9월에 떠난다.

summary: 서해안, 남해안, 동해안의 섬에 사는 새로, 대나무 숲이나 관목·잡목 숲에서 지내며 가끔 밭이나 인가 근처까지 내려와 먹이를 찾는다. 곤충을 주로 먹고 복족류 같은 연체동물도 잡아먹는다. 대나무 줄기나 나뭇가지 사이에 둥지를 틀고 5~6월에 알 4개를 낳는다. 국외에서는 일본과 중국 동부에 분포한다.

points.en: greyish-white tips to the outer tail feathers

young: 어른새와 비슷하나 첫겨울 어린새는 눈썹선과 멱, 윗가슴에 노란 기가 돌고 아랫멱에 흐린 점무늬가 있다. 어린새는 입가가 노르스름하다.

similar.how: 알락꼬리쥐발귀는 조금 작고 부리가 짧으며, 윗면이 붉은 기 도는 갈색이고 아랫면이 크림색을 띤다.

art.subject: Styan's Grasshopper Warbler (Locustella pleskei), adult in the breeding season (May–August), sexes alike: upperparts plain, unstreaked olive-brown with a greyish tone; rump and uppertail coverts slightly warmer buff-brown; a narrow, rather faint pale greyish supercilium and an indistinct brownish eye-stripe; wings plain olive-brown; tail olive-brown and rounded, the outer feathers with greyish-white tips; underparts white, washed greyish-brown on the breast sides and flanks; long, strong bill, dark above and pinkish below; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched between bamboo stems, side view
art.scene: bamboo thicket and scrub on a Korean coastal island in early summer; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched among bamboo stems: plain unstreaked olive-brown upperparts, pale greyish-white supercilium, warmer buff-brown rump, white underparts with greyish flanks, long strong bill, pinkish legs
adult, perched and seen from below and behind: rounded olive-brown tail with greyish-white tips to the outer feathers, buff-brown rump and uppertail coverts, white belly
art.build: Rather stout Locustella warbler, about 14cm — about sparrow length but slimmer and longer-tailed. Flat forehead and a long, strong bill for its size, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish and strong. Wings short; at rest the wingtips reach only a short way past the base of the tail. Tail fairly long, broad and graduated. Skulks in dense bamboo and scrub on coastal islands, but the male sings from the top of a bush.
avoid: Do not streak the upperparts; unlike Pallas's and Lanceolated Grasshopper Warblers this species is plain olive-brown above.
Do not make it as large and long-billed as Oriental Reed Warbler (Acrocephalus orientalis) or give it a peaked crown.
Do not paint yellow underparts; they are white with greyish flanks.
Do not omit the greyish-white tips to the outer tail feathers.
